extras.workflow_content:
# NuGuard AI - Backend CI/CD Pipeline — OIDC auth (Workload Identity Federation)
# Builds and deploys all FastAPI services to Azure Container Apps
# Last updated: 2026-02-20 — replace nginx gateway with APIM + ACA external ingress
#
# Services:
#   - data-service: Core REST API (PostgreSQL, CRUD, scan orchestration)
#   - ai-asset-service: AIBOM extraction from repositories
#   - assessment-service: Compliance assessment against AIBOM graphs
#   - red-team-service: Adversarial testing orchestration
#   - ai-chatbot-service: SSE-based streaming chat
#   - sn-integration-service: ServiceNow integration API
#
# API Gateway: Azure API Management (Consumption tier) — see infra/apim.bicep
#   One-time setup: run the "Provision APIM" workflow (infra-apim.yml) manually.
#   Per-deploy: CI/CD switches backend services to external ACA ingress and
#   updates APIM backend URLs to the new service FQDNs.
#
# Environments:
#   - develop branch → Dev (api-dev.nuguard.ai via nuguard-apim-dev)
#   - main branch → Staging (api-staging.nuguard.ai via nuguard-apim-staging)
#   - release/* tags → Production (api.nuguard.ai via nuguard-apim)

name: Backend CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'backend/**'
      - 'infra/**'
      - '.github/workflows/backend.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'backend/**'
      - 'infra/**'
  release:
    types: [published]

env:
  REGISTRY: nuguardacr.azurecr.io
  PYTHON_VERSION: '3.12'

jobs:
  # ============================================================
  # Lint & Type Check
  # ============================================================
  lint:
    name: Lint & Type Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || !(github.head_ref == 'develop' && github.base_ref == 'main')
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: 'pip'
          cache-dependency-path: backend/requirements.txt

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
          pip install ruff mypy types-python-jose types-passlib

      - name: Run Ruff (linter)
        run: |
          cd backend && ruff check . --output-format=github

      - name: Run MyPy (type check)
        run: |
          cd backend && mypy --ignore-missing-imports .
        continue-on-error: true

  # ============================================================
  # Unit & Integration Tests
  # ============================================================
  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    permissions:
      contents: read

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
          POSTGRES_DB: nuguard_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: 'pip'
          cache-dependency-path: backend/requirements.txt

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
          pip install pytest pytest-asyncio pytest-cov pytest-xdist pytest-timeout httpx

      - name: Run tests
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://test:test@localhost:5432/nuguard_test
          JWT_SECRET_KEY: test-secret-key-for-ci
          GEMINI_API_KEY: test-key
        run: |
          cd backend && pytest \
            -n auto \
            --cov=. \
            --cov-report=xml \
            --cov-report=term-missing \
            --junit-xml=test-results.xml \
            --timeout=120 \
            --ignore=tests/test_stage1_integration.py

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: backend/test-results.xml

      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          file: backend/coverage.xml
          flags: backend
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  # ============================================================
  # Security Scan
  # ============================================================
  security:
    name: Security Scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    permissions:
      contents: read
      security-events: write
      actions: read

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scanner
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.35.0
        with:
          scan-type: 'fs'
          scan-ref: 'backend'
          format: 'sarif'
          output: 'trivy-results.sarif'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'

      - name: Upload Trivy scan results
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v4
        with:
          sarif_file: 'trivy-results.sarif'

  # ============================================================
  # Generate image tag (single job, shared by all parallel builds)
  # ============================================================
  tag:
    name: Generate Tag
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Security scan runs in parallel and uploads SARIF independently — it does NOT
    # gate builds. Removing it from needs shaves the full Trivy scan duration
    # (typically 2-5 min) off the critical path to 9 parallel Docker builds.
    needs: [test]
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'release'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      image_tag: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - name: Generate image tag
        id: meta
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "release" ]]; then
            RAW="${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          else
            RAW=${GITHUB_SHA::8}
          fi
          # Azure Container Apps revision suffix: lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens only
          VERSION=$(echo "${RAW}" | tr '.' '-' | tr '_' '-' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
          echo "version=${VERSION}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Image tag: ${VERSION}"

  # ============================================================
  # Build Docker Images — all services in parallel
  # ============================================================
  build:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.service }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [tag]
    # 'ci' environment for OIDC subject matching (no protection rules)
    environment: ${{ github.event_name == 'release' && 'production' || 'ci' }}
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
      actions: write   # required for type=gha layer cache

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false   # keep building other images if one fails
      matrix:
        include:
          - service: data-service
            dockerfile: backend/data_service/Dockerfile
            context: backend
          - service: ai-asset-service
            dockerfile: backend/ai_asset_service/Dockerfile
            context: backend
          - service: assessment-service
            dockerfile: backend/assessment_service/Dockerfile
            context: backend
          - service: red-team-service
            dockerfile: backend/red_team_service/Dockerfile
            context: backend
          - service: ai-chatbot-service
            dockerfile: backend/ai_chatbot_service/Dockerfile
            context: .
          - service: sn-integration-service
            dockerfile: backend/sn_integration_service/Dockerfile
            context: backend
          - service: behavior-service
            dockerfile: backend/behavior_service/Dockerfile
            context: backend
          - service: gateway
            dockerfile: backend/gateway/Dockerfile
            context: backend/gateway
          - service: migrate
            dockerfile: backend/base/Dockerfile
            context: backend

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Azure Login (OIDC)
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Login to ACR
        run: az acr login --name nuguardacr

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build and push ${{ matrix.service }}
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: ${{ matrix.context }}
          file: ${{ matrix.dockerfile }}
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ matrix.service }}:${{ needs.tag.outputs.image_tag }}
            ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ matrix.service }}:latest
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=${{ matrix.service }}
          cache-to: type=gha,scope=${{ matrix.service }},mode=max

  # ============================================================
  # Deploy to Development (develop branch)
  # ============================================================
  deploy-dev:
    name: Deploy to Development
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [build, tag, migrate]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
    environment:
      name: development
      url: https://api-dev.nuguard.ai
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Azure Login (OIDC)
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Ensure sn-integration-service-dev exists
        run: |
          TAG=${{ needs.tag.outputs.image_tag }}
          RG=Dev
          SUFFIX="-dev"
          SVC="sn-integration-service"
          APP_NAME="${SVC}${SUFFIX}"
          KV_NAME=nuguard-dev-kv

          if az containerapp show --name "$APP_NAME" --resource-group "$RG" --output none 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "$APP_NAME already exists"
            exit 0
          fi

          ENV_ID=$(az containerapp show --name "data-service${SUFFIX}" --resource-group "$RG" --query properties.managedEnvironmentId -o tsv)
          IDENTITY_ID=$(az containerapp show --name "data-service${SUFFIX}" --resource-group "$RG" --query "identity.userAssignedIdentities | keys(@)[0]" -o tsv)
          JWT_SECRET=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name nuguard-jwt-secret --query value -o tsv)

          echo "::add-mask::$JWT_SECRET"

          az containerapp create \
            --name "$APP_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --environment "$ENV_ID" \
            --image "${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${SVC}:${TAG}" \
            --ingress internal \
            --target-port 8007 \
            --min-replicas 1 \
            --max-replicas 2 \
            --cpu 0.25 \
            --memory 0.5Gi \
            --user-assigned "$IDENTITY_ID" \
            --registry-server "${{ env.REGISTRY }}" \
            --registry-identity "$IDENTITY_ID" \
            --secrets jwt-secret="$JWT_SECRET" \
            --env-vars \
              ENVIRONMENT=development \
              JWT_SECRET_KEY=secretref:jwt-secret \
              CORS_ORIGINS='["https://dev.nuguard.ai","http://localhost:3000","http://localhost:5173"]' \
            --output none

      - name: Ensure behavior-service-dev exists
        run: |
          TAG=${{ needs.tag.outputs.image_tag }}
          RG=Dev
          SUFFIX="-dev"
          SVC="behavior-service"
          APP_NAME="${SVC}${SUFFIX}"
          KV_NAME=nuguard-dev-kv

          if az containerapp show --name "$APP_NAME" --resource-group "$RG" --output none 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "$APP_NAME already exists"
            exit 0
          fi

          ENV_ID=$(az containerapp show --name "data-service${SUFFIX}" --resource-group "$RG" --query properties.managedEnvironmentId -o tsv)
          IDENTITY_ID=$(az containerapp show --name "data-service${SUFFIX}" --resource-group "$RG" --query "identity.userAssignedIdentities | keys(@)[0]" -o tsv)
          JWT_SECRET=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name nuguard-jwt-secret --query value -o tsv)
          DB_URL=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name DATABASE-URL --query value -o tsv)

          echo "::add-mask::$JWT_SECRET"
          echo "::add-mask::$DB_URL"

          az containerapp create \
            --name "$APP_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --environment "$ENV_ID" \
            --image "${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${SVC}:${TAG}" \
            --ingress internal \
            --target-port 8003 \
            --min-replicas 1 \
            --max-replicas 2 \
            --cpu 0.5 \
            --memory 1.0Gi \
            --user-assigned "$IDENTITY_ID" \
            --registry-server "${{ env.REGISTRY }}" \
            --registry-identity "$IDENTITY_ID" \
            --secrets jwt-secret="$JWT_SECRET" database-url="$DB_URL" \
            --env-vars \
              ENVIRONMENT=development \
              JWT_SECRET_KEY=secretref:jwt-secret \
              DATABASE_URL=secretref:database-url \
              CORS_ORIGINS='["https://dev.nuguard.ai","http://localhost:3000","http://localhost:5173"]' \
            --output none

      - name: Ensure behavior-service-dev has DATABASE_URL
        run: |
          # Idempotent patch — injects DATABASE_URL into already-running behavior-service-dev.
          # Safe to run on every deploy; ACA ignores secret updates when value is unchanged.
          KV_NAME=nuguard-dev-kv
          RG=Dev
          DB_URL=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name DATABASE-URL --query value -o tsv)
          echo "::add-mask::$DB_URL"
          az containerapp secret set \
            --name behavior-service-dev \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --secrets database-url="$DB_URL" \
            --output none || true
          az containerapp update \
            --name behavior-service-dev \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --set-env-vars DATABASE_URL=secretref:database-url \
            --output none || true

      - name: Ensure red-team-service-dev has DATABASE_URL
        run: |
          # Idempotent patch — injects DATABASE_URL into already-running red-team-service-dev.
          # Safe to run on every deploy; ACA ignores secret updates when value is unchanged.
          KV_NAME=nuguard-dev-kv
          RG=Dev
          DB_URL=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name DATABASE-URL --query value -o tsv)
          echo "::add-mask::$DB_URL"
          az containerapp secret set \
            --name red-team-service-dev \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --secrets database-url="$DB_URL" \
            --output none || true
          az containerapp update \
            --name red-team-service-dev \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --set-env-vars DATABASE_URL=secretref:database-url \
            --output none || true

      # LLM API keys (Gemini, Azure OpenAI, Kimi K2, Anthropic) are managed as
      # Key Vault-backed secrets by the Bicep template (infra/main.bicep).
      # They auto-refresh from nuguard-dev-kv and persist across image updates.
      # To change keys: update the KV secret value, no redeploy needed.
      # To add new keys: re-run Bicep deployment after updating main.bicep.

      - name: Patch LLM env vars for all needsLlm services (Dev)
        env:
          # Only the API key is a secret. All other LLM config is hardcoded below.
          DEV_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEV_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY }}
        run: |
          # IMPORTANT: This step must run BEFORE 'Deploy backend services to Dev'.
          # 'az containerapp secret set' patches configuration.secrets with plain
          # values WITHOUT creating a new revision. Once secrets are plain values,
          # the subsequent image-deploy step ('az containerapp update --image')
          # creates a new revision that passes secret validation and starts with
          # the correct LLM env vars (via the existing secretref wiring in the
          # Bicep template).
          #
          # The Bicep template wires all LLM env vars via keyvaultref secrets.
          # Those KV secrets don't exist in dev, so any revision creation fails
          # until we patch them here first.
          RG=Dev
          SUFFIX="-dev"
          AOI_ENDPOINT="https://ng-ai-foundary.cognitiveservices.azure.com/"
          AOI_DEPLOYMENT="gpt-4.1"
          AOI_APIVERSION="2025-01-01-preview"

          if [ -z "$DEV_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY" ]; then
            echo "DEV_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY secret not set — skipping LLM patch"
            echo "Add it at: Settings → Secrets → Actions → New repository secret"
            exit 0
          fi

          for SVC in ai-asset-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service assessment-service; do
            SVC_NAME="${SVC}${SUFFIX}"
            echo "--- Patching ${SVC_NAME} ---"

            # Wait for any in-progress ACA provisioning to finish before patching.
            # ACA returns ContainerAppOperationInProgress when a previous operation
            # (e.g. a parallel or recently completed deploy) hasn't released the lock.
            for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
              PROV=$(az containerapp show --name "$SVC_NAME" --resource-group "$RG" \
                --query properties.provisioningState -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "Unknown")
              if [[ "$PROV" == "Succeeded" || "$PROV" == "Failed" || "$PROV" == "Canceled" ]]; then
                break
              fi
              echo "  ${SVC_NAME} provisioningState=${PROV}, waiting 20s (attempt ${attempt}/5)..."
              sleep 20
            done

            # Overwrite all 19 keyvaultref secrets with plain values.
            # 'az containerapp secret set' does NOT create a new revision.
            for attempt in 1 2 3; do
              az containerapp secret set \
                --name "$SVC_NAME" \
                --resource-group "$RG" \
                --secrets \
                  "azure-openai-key=${DEV_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY}" \
                  "azure-openai-endpoint=${AOI_ENDPOINT}" \
                  "azure-openai-deployment-name=${AOI_DEPLOYMENT}" \
                  "azure-openai-model-name=${AOI_DEPLOYMENT}" \
                  "azure-openai-api-version=${AOI_APIVERSION}" \
                  "litellm-model=azure/${AOI_DEPLOYMENT}" \
                  "llm-default-provider=azure_openai" \
                  "gemini-api-key=not-configured" \
                  "gemini-model-name=not-configured" \
                  "google-cloud-project=not-configured" \
                  "vertex-ai-location=not-configured" \
                  "azure-kimi-k2-endpoint=not-configured" \
                  "azure-kimi-k2-key=not-configured" \
                  "azure-kimi-k2-model-name=not-configured" \
                  "azure-kimi-k2-deployment-name=not-configured" \
                  "azure-anthropic-endpoint=not-configured" \
                  "azure-anthropic-key=not-configured" \
                  "azure-anthropic-model-name=not-configured" \
                  "github-token=not-configured" \
                --output none \
              && echo "  Secrets patched for ${SVC_NAME}" && break \
              || {
                if [[ $attempt -lt 3 ]]; then
                  echo "  secret set failed (attempt ${attempt}/3), retrying in 30s..."
                  sleep 30
                else
                  echo "ERROR: secret set for ${SVC_NAME} failed after 3 attempts"; exit 1
                fi
              }
            done
          done

      - name: Deploy backend services to Dev
        run: |
          TAG=${{ needs.tag.outputs.image_tag }}
          RG=Dev
          SUFFIX="-dev"
          # Internal ACA URLs for service-to-service calls (unchanged — internal ingress
          # still works within the ACA environment even when external is also enabled)
          EXTRA_VARS="DATA_SERVICE_URL=http://data-service${SUFFIX}:80 AI_ASSET_SERVICE_URL=http://ai-asset-service${SUFFIX}:80 ASSESSMENT_SERVICE_URL=http://assessment-service${SUFFIX}:80 RED_TEAM_SERVICE_URL=http://red-team-service${SUFFIX}:80 SN_INTEGRATION_SERVICE_URL=http://sn-integration-service${SUFFIX}:80"

          # Parallelise all 7 image updates — each is independent of the others.
          # All az CLI calls write to separate FDs; errors are surfaced via wait.
          PIDS=()
          for SVC in data-service ai-asset-service assessment-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service sn-integration-service; do
            echo "Deploying ${SVC}..."
            az containerapp update \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" \
              --resource-group $RG \
              --image "${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${SVC}:${TAG}" \
              --set-env-vars ENVIRONMENT=development ${EXTRA_VARS} \
              --output none 2>&1 | sed "s/^/  [${SVC}] /" &
            PIDS+=($!)
          done
          FAIL=0; for PID in "${PIDS[@]}"; do wait $PID || FAIL=1; done
          [ $FAIL -eq 0 ] && echo "All services deployed" || echo "Warning: one or more service deploys failed"

      - name: Set LLM env vars for needsLlm services (Dev)
        env:
          DEV_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEV_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY }}
        run: |
          # The Bicep secretref env var wiring only exists in the revision template if
          # Bicep has been re-run for dev, so we set env vars explicitly here.
          #
          # All vars are collected into a single space-separated string and expanded
          # unquoted (same pattern as EXTRA_VARS in the deploy step) to avoid az CLI
          # nargs parsing issues with multiple separately quoted arguments.
          #
          # AZURE_API_BASE / AZURE_API_VERSION: litellm reads these directly for
          # azure/* model calls (it does NOT read AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT).
          # AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT / AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION: read by shared/llm_service
          # (ai-chatbot-service, assessment-service) which uses a separate LLM stack.
          if [ -z "$DEV_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY" ]; then
            echo "DEV_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY not set — skipping"
            exit 0
          fi
          RG=Dev
          SUFFIX="-dev"
          AOI_ENDPOINT="https://ng-ai-foundary.cognitiveservices.azure.com/"
          AOI_DEPLOYMENT="gpt-4.1"
          AOI_APIVERSION="2025-01-01-preview"
          LLM_VARS="AZURE_OPENAI_KEY=${DEV_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY}"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT=$AOI_ENDPOINT"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT_NAME=$AOI_DEPLOYMENT"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS AZURE_OPENAI_MODEL_NAME=$AOI_DEPLOYMENT"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION=$AOI_APIVERSION"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS AZURE_API_BASE=$AOI_ENDPOINT"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS AZURE_API_VERSION=$AOI_APIVERSION"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS LITELLM_MODEL=azure/$AOI_DEPLOYMENT"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS LLM_DEFAULT_PROVIDER=azure_openai"
          # NUGUARD_ENABLE_LLM defaults to true via code (use_nuguard_extractor=True in config.py)
          for SVC in ai-asset-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service assessment-service; do
            echo "Setting LLM env vars on ${SVC}${SUFFIX}..."
            az containerapp update \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" \
              --resource-group "$RG" \
              --set-env-vars $LLM_VARS \
              --output none \
            && echo "  Done ${SVC}${SUFFIX}" \
            || { echo "ERROR: LLM env var update for ${SVC}${SUFFIX} failed"; exit 1; }
          done

      - name: Set JWT_SECRET_KEY for ai-chatbot-service (Dev)
        run: |
          RG=Dev
          SUFFIX="-dev"
          KV_NAME=nuguard-dev-kv
          JWT_SECRET=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name nuguard-jwt-secret --query value -o tsv)
          echo "::add-mask::$JWT_SECRET"
          az containerapp secret set \
            --name "ai-chatbot-service${SUFFIX}" \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --secrets jwt-secret="$JWT_SECRET" \
            --output none \
          && az containerapp update \
            --name "ai-chatbot-service${SUFFIX}" \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --set-env-vars JWT_SECRET_KEY=secretref:jwt-secret \
            --output none \
          || echo "Warning: JWT inject for ai-chatbot-service-dev failed"

      - name: Set OAuth env vars for data-service (Dev)
        run: |
          # Pulls OAuth client IDs/secrets from nuguard-dev-kv and wires them to
          # data-service-dev as ACA secrets (not visible in revision templates).
          # OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE_URL / OAUTH_FRONTEND_BASE_URL are plain env vars.
          # If KV secrets are absent, the step skips gracefully — sign-in buttons
          # will return HTTP 501 until the secrets are added to the vault.
          # See: imp_docs/nuguard_auth.md for setup instructions.
          RG=Dev
          SUFFIX="-dev"
          KV_NAME=nuguard-dev-kv

          GH_ID=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name oauth-github-client-id --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          GH_SECRET=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name oauth-github-client-secret --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          GOOGLE_ID=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name oauth-google-client-id --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          GOOGLE_SECRET=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name oauth-google-client-secret --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          MS_ID=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name oauth-microsoft-client-id --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          MS_SECRET=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name oauth-microsoft-client-secret --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")

          if [[ -z "$GH_ID" && -z "$GOOGLE_ID" && -z "$MS_ID" ]]; then
            echo "No OAuth secrets found in $KV_NAME — skipping social sign-in setup."
            echo "Add oauth-github-client-id, oauth-google-client-id, oauth-microsoft-client-id to the vault to enable sign-in."
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "::add-mask::$GH_SECRET"
          echo "::add-mask::$GOOGLE_SECRET"
          echo "::add-mask::$MS_SECRET"

          az containerapp secret set \
            --name "data-service${SUFFIX}" \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --secrets \
              "oauth-github-client-id=${GH_ID}" \
              "oauth-github-client-secret=${GH_SECRET}" \
              "oauth-google-client-id=${GOOGLE_ID}" \
              "oauth-google-client-secret=${GOOGLE_SECRET}" \
              "oauth-microsoft-client-id=${MS_ID}" \
              "oauth-microsoft-client-secret=${MS_SECRET}" \
            --output none

          az containerapp update \
            --name "data-service${SUFFIX}" \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --set-env-vars \
              OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=secretref:oauth-github-client-id \
              OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=secretref:oauth-github-client-secret \
              OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=secretref:oauth-google-client-id \
              OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=secretref:oauth-google-client-secret \
              OAUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID=secretref:oauth-microsoft-client-id \
              OAUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET=secretref:oauth-microsoft-client-secret \
              OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE_URL=https://api-dev.nuguard.ai \
              OAUTH_FRONTEND_BASE_URL=https://dev.nuguard.ai \
            --output none \
          && echo "OAuth env vars set for data-service${SUFFIX}" \
          || echo "Warning: OAuth env var update for data-service${SUFFIX} failed"

      - name: Set CORS origins for backend services
        run: |
          RG=Dev
          SUFFIX="-dev"
          for SVC in data-service ai-asset-service assessment-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service sn-integration-service; do
            az containerapp update \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" \
              --resource-group $RG \
              --set-env-vars 'CORS_ORIGINS=["https://dev.nuguard.ai","http://localhost:3000","http://localhost:5173"]' \
            || echo "Warning: CORS update for ${SVC} failed"
          done

      - name: Enable internal-only ACA ingress on backend services
        run: |
          RG=Dev
          SUFFIX="-dev"
          declare -A PORTS=(
            ["data-service"]="8000"
            ["ai-asset-service"]="8004"
            ["assessment-service"]="8005"
            ["red-team-service"]="8002"
            ["behavior-service"]="8003"
            ["ai-chatbot-service"]="8006"
            ["sn-integration-service"]="8007"
          )
          for SVC in data-service ai-asset-service assessment-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service sn-integration-service; do
            PORT="${PORTS[$SVC]}"
            az containerapp ingress update \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" --resource-group "$RG" \
              --type internal 2>/dev/null \
            || az containerapp ingress enable \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" --resource-group "$RG" \
              --type internal --target-port "$PORT" --transport auto 2>/dev/null \
            || echo "Warning: Could not set internal ingress for ${SVC}"
          done

      - name: Deploy nginx gateway to Dev
        run: |
          TAG=${{ needs.tag.outputs.image_tag }}
          RG=Dev
          SUFFIX="-dev"
          az containerapp update \
            --name "gateway${SUFFIX}" \
            --resource-group $RG \
            --image "${{ env.REGISTRY }}/gateway:${TAG}" \
            --set-env-vars \
              DATA_SERVICE_HOST=data-service${SUFFIX}:80 \
              DATA_SERVICE_NAME=data-service${SUFFIX} \
              AI_ASSET_SERVICE_HOST=ai-asset-service${SUFFIX}:80 \
              AI_ASSET_SERVICE_NAME=ai-asset-service${SUFFIX} \
              ASSESSMENT_SERVICE_HOST=assessment-service${SUFFIX}:80 \
              ASSESSMENT_SERVICE_NAME=assessment-service${SUFFIX} \
              RED_TEAM_SERVICE_HOST=red-team-service${SUFFIX}:80 \
              RED_TEAM_SERVICE_NAME=red-team-service${SUFFIX} \
              AI_CHATBOT_SERVICE_HOST=ai-chatbot-service${SUFFIX}:80 \
              AI_CHATBOT_SERVICE_NAME=ai-chatbot-service${SUFFIX} \
              BEHAVIOR_SERVICE_HOST=behavior-service${SUFFIX}:80 \
              BEHAVIOR_SERVICE_NAME=behavior-service${SUFFIX} \
                SN_INTEGRATION_SERVICE_HOST=sn-integration-service${SUFFIX}:80 \
                SN_INTEGRATION_SERVICE_NAME=sn-integration-service${SUFFIX} \
              NGINX_RESOLVER=168.63.129.16 \
              NGINX_FRONTEND_URL=off \
          || echo "Warning: gateway deploy failed (may not exist yet — run Bicep first)"

      - name: Ensure minimum replicas (prevent scale-to-zero in Dev)
        run: |
          RG=Dev
          SUFFIX="-dev"
          for SVC in data-service ai-asset-service assessment-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service sn-integration-service; do
            az containerapp update \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" \
              --resource-group $RG \
              --min-replicas 1 --output none \
            || echo "Warning: min-replicas update for ${SVC} failed"
          done

      - name: Remove CPU/memory scale rules from red-team-service (Dev)
        run: |
          # red-team-service runs one scan per asyncio task in a single process.
          # CPU/memory scale-out adds a new replica mid-scan which incorrectly
          # marks the in-flight run as service_restarted. HTTP scaling is enough.
          az containerapp update \
            --name "red-team-service-dev" \
            --resource-group Dev \
            --remove-all-scale-rules \
            --output none \
          && az containerapp update \
            --name "red-team-service-dev" \
            --resource-group Dev \
            --scale-rule-name http-scaling \
            --scale-rule-type http \
            --scale-rule-http-concurrency 100 \
            --output none \
          || echo "Warning: scale rule update for red-team-service-dev failed"

      - name: Deactivate old revisions
        run: |
          RG=Dev
          SUFFIX="-dev"
          for SVC in data-service ai-asset-service assessment-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service sn-integration-service; do
            LATEST=$(az containerapp revision list \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" --resource-group $RG \
              --query "[-1].name" -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
            if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then continue; fi
            OLD=$(az containerapp revision list \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" --resource-group $RG \
              --query "[?properties.active && name!='${LATEST}'].name" -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
            for REV in $OLD; do
              az containerapp revision deactivate \
                --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" --resource-group $RG \
                --revision "$REV" --output none 2>/dev/null \
              && echo "Deactivated ${REV}" || true
            done
          done

      - name: Health check
        run: |
          GATEWAY_FQDN=$(az containerapp show --name "gateway-dev" --resource-group Dev \
            --query "properties.configuration.ingress.fqdn" -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          if [ -z "$GATEWAY_FQDN" ]; then
            echo "Warning: Could not resolve gateway FQDN — skipping health check"
          else
            echo "Polling https://${GATEWAY_FQDN}/health (max 3 min)..."
            for i in $(seq 1 36); do
              if curl -sf "https://${GATEWAY_FQDN}/health" > /dev/null; then
                echo "✅ Gateway healthy after $((i * 5))s"
                break
              fi
              echo "  attempt $i/36 — waiting 5s..."
              sleep 5
              [ $i -eq 36 ] && echo "Warning: Health check still failing after 3 min"
            done
          fi

      - name: Notify deployment
        run: |
          echo "✅ Deployed to Development: https://api-dev.nuguard.ai"

  # ============================================================
  # Deploy to Staging (main branch)
  # ============================================================
  deploy-staging:
    name: Deploy to Staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [build, tag, migrate]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    environment:
      name: staging
      url: https://api-staging.nuguard.ai
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Azure Login (OIDC)
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      # LLM API keys are managed as Key Vault-backed secrets by Bicep (infra/main.bicep).
      # They auto-refresh from nuguard-stage-kv and persist across image updates.

      - name: Ensure sn-integration-service-staging exists
        run: |
          TAG=${{ needs.tag.outputs.image_tag }}
          RG=Stage
          SUFFIX="-staging"
          SVC="sn-integration-service"
          APP_NAME="${SVC}${SUFFIX}"
          KV_NAME=nuguard-stage-kv

          if az containerapp show --name "$APP_NAME" --resource-group "$RG" --output none 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "$APP_NAME already exists"
            exit 0
          fi

          ENV_ID=$(az containerapp show --name "data-service${SUFFIX}" --resource-group "$RG" --query properties.managedEnvironmentId -o tsv)
          IDENTITY_ID=$(az containerapp show --name "data-service${SUFFIX}" --resource-group "$RG" --query "identity.userAssignedIdentities | keys(@)[0]" -o tsv)
          JWT_SECRET=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name nuguard-jwt-secret --query value -o tsv)

          echo "::add-mask::$JWT_SECRET"

          az containerapp create \
            --name "$APP_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --environment "$ENV_ID" \
            --image "${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${SVC}:${TAG}" \
            --ingress internal \
            --target-port 8007 \
            --min-replicas 1 \
            --max-replicas 2 \
            --cpu 0.25 \
            --memory 0.5Gi \
            --user-assigned "$IDENTITY_ID" \
            --registry-server "${{ env.REGISTRY }}" \
            --registry-identity "$IDENTITY_ID" \
            --secrets jwt-secret="$JWT_SECRET" \
            --env-vars \
              ENVIRONMENT=staging \
              JWT_SECRET_KEY=secretref:jwt-secret \
              CORS_ORIGINS='["https://staging.nuguard.ai","https://demo.nuguard.ai","http://localhost:3000"]' \
            --output none

      - name: Ensure behavior-service-staging exists
        run: |
          TAG=${{ needs.tag.outputs.image_tag }}
          RG=Stage
          SUFFIX="-staging"
          SVC="behavior-service"
          APP_NAME="${SVC}${SUFFIX}"
          KV_NAME=nuguard-stage-kv

          if az containerapp show --name "$APP_NAME" --resource-group "$RG" --output none 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "$APP_NAME already exists"
            exit 0
          fi

          ENV_ID=$(az containerapp show --name "data-service${SUFFIX}" --resource-group "$RG" --query properties.managedEnvironmentId -o tsv)
          IDENTITY_ID=$(az containerapp show --name "data-service${SUFFIX}" --resource-group "$RG" --query "identity.userAssignedIdentities | keys(@)[0]" -o tsv)
          JWT_SECRET=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name nuguard-jwt-secret --query value -o tsv)
          DB_URL=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name DATABASE-URL --query value -o tsv)

          echo "::add-mask::$JWT_SECRET"
          echo "::add-mask::$DB_URL"

          az containerapp create \
            --name "$APP_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --environment "$ENV_ID" \
            --image "${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${SVC}:${TAG}" \
            --ingress internal \
            --target-port 8003 \
            --min-replicas 1 \
            --max-replicas 2 \
            --cpu 0.5 \
            --memory 1.0Gi \
            --user-assigned "$IDENTITY_ID" \
            --registry-server "${{ env.REGISTRY }}" \
            --registry-identity "$IDENTITY_ID" \
            --secrets jwt-secret="$JWT_SECRET" database-url="$DB_URL" \
            --env-vars \
              ENVIRONMENT=staging \
              JWT_SECRET_KEY=secretref:jwt-secret \
              DATABASE_URL=secretref:database-url \
              CORS_ORIGINS='["https://staging.nuguard.ai","https://demo.nuguard.ai","http://localhost:3000"]' \
            --output none

      - name: Ensure behavior-service-staging has DATABASE_URL
        run: |
          # Idempotent patch — injects DATABASE_URL into already-running behavior-service-staging.
          KV_NAME=nuguard-stage-kv
          RG=Stage
          DB_URL=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name DATABASE-URL --query value -o tsv)
          echo "::add-mask::$DB_URL"
          az containerapp secret set \
            --name behavior-service-staging \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --secrets database-url="$DB_URL" \
            --output none || true
          az containerapp update \
            --name behavior-service-staging \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --set-env-vars DATABASE_URL=secretref:database-url \
            --output none || true

      - name: Ensure red-team-service-staging has DATABASE_URL
        run: |
          # Idempotent patch — wires DATABASE_URL to the Bicep-provisioned database-url secret.
          # CI runner cannot read nuguard-stage-kv, so we skip the KV read and just wire
          # the secretref. The secret is resolved by the ACA managed identity at runtime.
          az containerapp update \
            --name red-team-service-staging \
            --resource-group Stage \
            --set-env-vars DATABASE_URL=secretref:database-url \
            --output none || true

      - name: Patch LLM env vars for all needsLlm services (Staging)
        env:
          # TODO: Replace DEV_* references below with dedicated STAGING_* secrets once
          # STAGING_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY, STAGING_AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT, etc. are added
          # as GitHub Actions repository secrets.
          STAGING_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEV_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY }}
          STAGING_AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.DEV_AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT }}
          STAGING_AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT_NAME: ${{ secrets.DEV_AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT_NAME }}
          STAGING_AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION: ${{ secrets.DEV_AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION }}
          STAGING_GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEV_GEMINI_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          # IMPORTANT: This step runs BEFORE 'Deploy backend services to Staging'.
          # Step 1: Overwrite Bicep-wired keyvaultref secrets with plain values so that
          # the subsequent image-deploy creates a new revision that resolves them. This
          # matches the dev pattern — without it, keyvaultref-backed secretrefs fail if
          # the KV entry is missing or the CI runner cannot read the KV.
          # Step 2: Also set plain env vars (--set-env-vars) for services that read them
          # directly from the environment rather than via secretref wiring.
          RG=Stage
          SUFFIX="-staging"
          KV_NAME=nuguard-stage-kv

          # Try Key Vault first (staging KV is more likely to have secrets populated)
          AOI_KEY=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name azure-openai-key --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          AOI_ENDPOINT=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name azure-openai-endpoint --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          AOI_DEPLOYMENT=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name azure-openai-deployment-name --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          AOI_MODEL=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name azure-openai-model-name --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          AOI_APIVERSION=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name azure-openai-api-version --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          GEMINI_KEY=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name gemini-api-key --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")

          # Fall back to GitHub Actions secrets / hardcoded dev values if KV returned nothing.
          # Only the API key is a true secret. Endpoint/deployment/version are hardcoded
          # (same values as dev) until dedicated STAGING_* secrets are configured.
          # TODO: Replace hardcoded values with $STAGING_* secret refs once those are added.
          AOI_KEY="${AOI_KEY:-$STAGING_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY}"
          AOI_ENDPOINT="${AOI_ENDPOINT:-https://ng-ai-foundary.cognitiveservices.azure.com/}"
          AOI_DEPLOYMENT="${AOI_DEPLOYMENT:-gpt-4.1}"
          AOI_APIVERSION="${AOI_APIVERSION:-2025-01-01-preview}"
          GEMINI_KEY="${GEMINI_KEY:-}"

          echo "::add-mask::$AOI_KEY"
          echo "::add-mask::$GEMINI_KEY"

          if [ -z "$AOI_KEY" ]; then
            echo "No LLM credentials found in KV or GitHub Actions secrets — skipping patch"
            exit 0
          fi

          for SVC in ai-asset-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service assessment-service; do
            SVC_NAME="${SVC}${SUFFIX}"
            echo "--- Patching ${SVC_NAME} ---"

            # Wait for any in-progress ACA provisioning to finish before patching.
            for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
              PROV=$(az containerapp show --name "$SVC_NAME" --resource-group "$RG" \
                --query properties.provisioningState -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "Unknown")
              if [[ "$PROV" == "Succeeded" || "$PROV" == "Failed" || "$PROV" == "Canceled" ]]; then
                break
              fi
              echo "  ${SVC_NAME} provisioningState=${PROV}, waiting 20s (attempt ${attempt}/5)..."
              sleep 20
            done

            # Overwrite all 19 keyvaultref secrets with plain values.
            # 'az containerapp secret set' does NOT create a new revision.
            for attempt in 1 2 3; do
              az containerapp secret set \
                --name "$SVC_NAME" \
                --resource-group "$RG" \
                --secrets \
                  "azure-openai-key=${AOI_KEY}" \
                  "azure-openai-endpoint=${AOI_ENDPOINT}" \
                  "azure-openai-deployment-name=${AOI_DEPLOYMENT}" \
                  "azure-openai-model-name=${AOI_DEPLOYMENT}" \
                  "azure-openai-api-version=${AOI_APIVERSION}" \
                  "litellm-model=azure/${AOI_DEPLOYMENT}" \
                  "llm-default-provider=azure_openai" \
                  "gemini-api-key=not-configured" \
                  "gemini-model-name=not-configured" \
                  "google-cloud-project=not-configured" \
                  "vertex-ai-location=not-configured" \
                  "azure-kimi-k2-endpoint=not-configured" \
                  "azure-kimi-k2-key=not-configured" \
                  "azure-kimi-k2-model-name=not-configured" \
                  "azure-kimi-k2-deployment-name=not-configured" \
                  "azure-anthropic-endpoint=not-configured" \
                  "azure-anthropic-key=not-configured" \
                  "azure-anthropic-model-name=not-configured" \
                  "github-token=not-configured" \
                  "redteam-model-name=not-configured" \
                  "redteam-model-provider=not-configured" \
                  "redteam-model-key=not-configured" \
                  "redteam-model-endpoint=not-configured" \
                --output none \
              && echo "  Secrets patched for ${SVC_NAME}" && break \
              || {
                if [[ $attempt -lt 3 ]]; then
                  echo "  secret set failed (attempt ${attempt}/3), retrying in 30s..."
                  sleep 30
                else
                  echo "ERROR: secret set for ${SVC_NAME} failed after 3 attempts"; exit 1
                fi
              }
            done
          done

          # Also set plain env vars (--set-env-vars) for services that read them directly.
          LLM_VARS="AZURE_OPENAI_KEY=${AOI_KEY}"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT=${AOI_ENDPOINT} AZURE_API_BASE=${AOI_ENDPOINT}"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT_NAME=${AOI_DEPLOYMENT} AZURE_OPENAI_MODEL_NAME=${AOI_DEPLOYMENT}"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION=${AOI_APIVERSION} AZURE_API_VERSION=${AOI_APIVERSION}"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS LITELLM_MODEL=azure/${AOI_DEPLOYMENT} LLM_DEFAULT_PROVIDER=azure_openai"
          [ -n "$GEMINI_KEY" ] && LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS GEMINI_API_KEY=$GEMINI_KEY"

          echo "Applying LLM env vars to needsLlm services..."
          for SVC in ai-asset-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service assessment-service; do
            az containerapp update \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" \
              --resource-group "$RG" \
              --set-env-vars $LLM_VARS \
              --output none \
            || echo "Warning: LLM env var update for ${SVC}${SUFFIX} failed"
          done

      - name: Deploy backend services to Staging
        run: |
          TAG=${{ needs.tag.outputs.image_tag }}
          RG=Stage
          SUFFIX="-staging"
          EXTRA_VARS="DATA_SERVICE_URL=http://data-service${SUFFIX}:80 AI_ASSET_SERVICE_URL=http://ai-asset-service${SUFFIX}:80 ASSESSMENT_SERVICE_URL=http://assessment-service${SUFFIX}:80 RED_TEAM_SERVICE_URL=http://red-team-service${SUFFIX}:80 SN_INTEGRATION_SERVICE_URL=http://sn-integration-service${SUFFIX}:80"

          # Parallelise all 7 image updates — each is independent of the others.
          PIDS=()
          for SVC in data-service ai-asset-service assessment-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service sn-integration-service; do
            echo "Deploying ${SVC}..."
            az containerapp update \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" \
              --resource-group $RG \
              --image "${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${SVC}:${TAG}" \
              --set-env-vars ENVIRONMENT=staging ${EXTRA_VARS} \
              --output none 2>&1 | sed "s/^/  [${SVC}] /" &
            PIDS+=($!)
          done
          FAIL=0; for PID in "${PIDS[@]}"; do wait $PID || FAIL=1; done
          [ $FAIL -eq 0 ] && echo "All services deployed" || echo "Warning: one or more service deploys failed"

      - name: Set LLM env vars for needsLlm services (Staging)
        env:
          STAGING_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEV_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY }}
        run: |
          # Re-apply LLM env vars AFTER the image deploy step creates a new revision.
          # The image deploy step (above) uses --set-env-vars with ENVIRONMENT and
          # EXTRA_VARS only — it does not carry forward LLM vars into the new revision
          # unless they are explicitly re-applied here. This matches the dev pattern.
          #
          # AZURE_API_BASE / AZURE_API_VERSION: litellm reads these directly for
          # azure/* model calls (it does NOT read AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT).
          # AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT / AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION: read by shared/llm_service.
          if [ -z "$STAGING_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY" ]; then
            echo "STAGING_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY not set — skipping"
            exit 0
          fi
          RG=Stage
          SUFFIX="-staging"
          KV_NAME=nuguard-stage-kv
          AOI_KEY=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name azure-openai-key --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          AOI_KEY="${AOI_KEY:-$STAGING_AZURE_OPENAI_KEY}"
          AOI_ENDPOINT="https://ng-ai-foundary.cognitiveservices.azure.com/"
          AOI_DEPLOYMENT="gpt-4.1"
          AOI_APIVERSION="2025-01-01-preview"
          echo "::add-mask::$AOI_KEY"
          LLM_VARS="AZURE_OPENAI_KEY=${AOI_KEY}"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT=$AOI_ENDPOINT"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT_NAME=$AOI_DEPLOYMENT"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS AZURE_OPENAI_MODEL_NAME=$AOI_DEPLOYMENT"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION=$AOI_APIVERSION"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS AZURE_API_BASE=$AOI_ENDPOINT"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS AZURE_API_VERSION=$AOI_APIVERSION"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS LITELLM_MODEL=azure/$AOI_DEPLOYMENT"
          LLM_VARS="$LLM_VARS LLM_DEFAULT_PROVIDER=azure_openai"
          for SVC in ai-asset-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service assessment-service; do
            echo "Setting LLM env vars on ${SVC}${SUFFIX}..."
            az containerapp update \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" \
              --resource-group "$RG" \
              --set-env-vars $LLM_VARS \
              --output none \
            && echo "  Done ${SVC}${SUFFIX}" \
            || { echo "ERROR: LLM env var update for ${SVC}${SUFFIX} failed"; exit 1; }
          done

      - name: Set scan perf env vars for scan services (Staging)
        run: |
          # REDTEAM_TREE_BREADTH/MAX_DEPTH cap the TAP tree so red-team scans
          # fire at most 2x2=4 concurrent LLM streaming calls per scenario
          # instead of the default 3x3=9, keeping the asyncio event loop free
          # enough to respond to /health probes (preventing service_restarted).
          # RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=7200 caps the wall-clock scan time.
          # These vars were set via Bicep for dev (PR #351) but CI must set them
          # explicitly for staging on every deploy because Bicep is not re-run.
          RG=Stage
          SUFFIX="-staging"
          az containerapp update \
            --name "red-team-service${SUFFIX}" \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --set-env-vars \
              REDTEAM_TREE_BREADTH=2 \
              REDTEAM_TREE_MAX_DEPTH=2 \
              RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=7200 \
            --output none \
          || echo "Warning: scan perf vars for red-team-service${SUFFIX} failed"
          az containerapp update \
            --name "behavior-service${SUFFIX}" \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --set-env-vars RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=7200 \
            --output none \
          || echo "Warning: scan perf vars for behavior-service${SUFFIX} failed"

      - name: Ensure minimum replicas (prevent scale-to-zero in Staging)
        run: |
          RG=Stage
          SUFFIX="-staging"
          for SVC in data-service ai-asset-service assessment-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service sn-integration-service; do
            az containerapp update \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" \
              --resource-group $RG \
              --min-replicas 1 --output none \
            || echo "Warning: min-replicas update for ${SVC} failed"
          done

      - name: Set JWT_SECRET_KEY for auth-enabled services (Staging)
        run: |
          # behavior-service and red-team-service validate JWT tokens for all
          # authenticated endpoints. They need the same jwt-secret as data-service.
          # ai-chatbot-service also requires it for WebSocket auth.
          #
          # In staging the CI runner cannot read nuguard-stage-kv (no RBAC grant),
          # so we cannot patch the secret value itself. Instead we only wire the
          # JWT_SECRET_KEY env var to the existing jwt-secret (provisioned by Bicep
          # as a keyvaultref, resolved by the ACA managed identity at runtime).
          # This is idempotent and safe to run on every deploy.
          RG=Stage
          SUFFIX="-staging"
          for SVC in ai-chatbot-service behavior-service red-team-service; do
            az containerapp update \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" \
              --resource-group "$RG" \
              --set-env-vars JWT_SECRET_KEY=secretref:jwt-secret \
              --output none \
            && echo "JWT_SECRET_KEY wired for ${SVC}${SUFFIX}" \
            || echo "Warning: JWT wire for ${SVC}${SUFFIX} failed"
          done

      - name: Set OAuth env vars for data-service (Staging)
        env:
          STAGING_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.STAGING_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID }}
          STAGING_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.STAGING_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET }}
          STAGING_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.STAGING_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID }}
          STAGING_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.STAGING_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET }}
          STAGING_OAUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.STAGING_OAUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID }}
          STAGING_OAUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.STAGING_OAUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET }}
        run: |
          # CI runner may not have RBAC on nuguard-stage-kv, so we try KV first
          # and fall back to GitHub Actions secrets (STAGING_OAUTH_*).
          # If neither source has values, the step skips gracefully — existing
          # manually-set env vars on the container app are preserved across deploys.
          # See: imp_docs/nuguard_auth.md for setup instructions.
          RG=Stage
          SUFFIX="-staging"
          KV_NAME=nuguard-stage-kv

          GH_ID=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name oauth-github-client-id --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          GH_SECRET=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name oauth-github-client-secret --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          GOOGLE_ID=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name oauth-google-client-id --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          GOOGLE_SECRET=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name oauth-google-client-secret --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          MS_ID=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name oauth-microsoft-client-id --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          MS_SECRET=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name oauth-microsoft-client-secret --query value -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")

          # Fall back to GitHub Actions secrets if KV returned nothing
          GH_ID="${GH_ID:-$STAGING_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID}"
          GH_SECRET="${GH_SECRET:-$STAGING_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET}"
          GOOGLE_ID="${GOOGLE_ID:-$STAGING_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID}"
          GOOGLE_SECRET="${GOOGLE_SECRET:-$STAGING_OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET}"
          MS_ID="${MS_ID:-$STAGING_OAUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID}"
          MS_SECRET="${MS_SECRET:-$STAGING_OAUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET}"

          if [[ -z "$GH_ID" && -z "$GOOGLE_ID" && -z "$MS_ID" ]]; then
            echo "No OAuth credentials found in KV or GitHub secrets — skipping."
            echo "To source from KV: add oauth-github-client-id etc. to nuguard-stage-kv."
            echo "To source from GitHub: add STAGING_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID etc. as Actions secrets."
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "::add-mask::$GH_SECRET"
          echo "::add-mask::$GOOGLE_SECRET"
          echo "::add-mask::$MS_SECRET"

          az containerapp secret set \
            --name "data-service${SUFFIX}" \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --secrets \
              "oauth-github-client-id=${GH_ID}" \
              "oauth-github-client-secret=${GH_SECRET}" \
              "oauth-google-client-id=${GOOGLE_ID}" \
              "oauth-google-client-secret=${GOOGLE_SECRET}" \
              "oauth-microsoft-client-id=${MS_ID}" \
              "oauth-microsoft-client-secret=${MS_SECRET}" \
            --output none

          az containerapp update \
            --name "data-service${SUFFIX}" \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --set-env-vars \
              OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=secretref:oauth-github-client-id \
              OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=secretref:oauth-github-client-secret \
              OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=secretref:oauth-google-client-id \
              OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=secretref:oauth-google-client-secret \
              OAUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID=secretref:oauth-microsoft-client-id \
              OAUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET=secretref:oauth-microsoft-client-secret \
              OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE_URL=https://api-staging.nuguard.ai \
              OAUTH_FRONTEND_BASE_URL=https://staging.nuguard.ai \
            --output none \
          && echo "OAuth env vars set for data-service${SUFFIX}" \
          || echo "Warning: OAuth env var update for data-service${SUFFIX} failed"

      - name: Set CORS origins for backend services
        run: |
          RG=Stage
          SUFFIX="-staging"
          for SVC in data-service ai-asset-service assessment-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service sn-integration-service; do
            az containerapp update \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" \
              --resource-group $RG \
              --set-env-vars 'CORS_ORIGINS=["https://staging.nuguard.ai","https://demo.nuguard.ai","http://localhost:3000"]' \
            || echo "Warning: CORS update for ${SVC} failed"
          done

      - name: Enable internal-only ACA ingress on backend services
        run: |
          RG=Stage
          SUFFIX="-staging"
          declare -A PORTS=(
            ["data-service"]="8000"
            ["ai-asset-service"]="8004"
            ["assessment-service"]="8005"
            ["red-team-service"]="8002"
            ["behavior-service"]="8003"
            ["ai-chatbot-service"]="8006"
            ["sn-integration-service"]="8007"
          )
          for SVC in data-service ai-asset-service assessment-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service sn-integration-service; do
            PORT="${PORTS[$SVC]}"
            az containerapp ingress update \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" --resource-group "$RG" \
              --type internal 2>/dev/null \
            || az containerapp ingress enable \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" --resource-group "$RG" \
              --type internal --target-port "$PORT" --transport auto 2>/dev/null \
            || echo "Warning: Could not set internal ingress for ${SVC}"
          done

      - name: Deploy nginx gateway to Staging
        run: |
          TAG=${{ needs.tag.outputs.image_tag }}
          RG=Stage
          SUFFIX="-staging"
          az containerapp update \
            --name "gateway${SUFFIX}" \
            --resource-group $RG \
            --image "${{ env.REGISTRY }}/gateway:${TAG}" \
            --set-env-vars \
              DATA_SERVICE_HOST=data-service${SUFFIX}:80 \
              DATA_SERVICE_NAME=data-service${SUFFIX} \
              AI_ASSET_SERVICE_HOST=ai-asset-service${SUFFIX}:80 \
              AI_ASSET_SERVICE_NAME=ai-asset-service${SUFFIX} \
              ASSESSMENT_SERVICE_HOST=assessment-service${SUFFIX}:80 \
              ASSESSMENT_SERVICE_NAME=assessment-service${SUFFIX} \
              RED_TEAM_SERVICE_HOST=red-team-service${SUFFIX}:80 \
              RED_TEAM_SERVICE_NAME=red-team-service${SUFFIX} \
              AI_CHATBOT_SERVICE_HOST=ai-chatbot-service${SUFFIX}:80 \
              AI_CHATBOT_SERVICE_NAME=ai-chatbot-service${SUFFIX} \
              BEHAVIOR_SERVICE_HOST=behavior-service${SUFFIX}:80 \
              BEHAVIOR_SERVICE_NAME=behavior-service${SUFFIX} \
                SN_INTEGRATION_SERVICE_HOST=sn-integration-service${SUFFIX}:80 \
                SN_INTEGRATION_SERVICE_NAME=sn-integration-service${SUFFIX} \
              NGINX_RESOLVER=168.63.129.16 \
              NGINX_FRONTEND_URL=off \
          || echo "Warning: gateway deploy failed (may not exist yet — run Bicep first)"

      - name: Remove CPU/memory scale rules from red-team-service (Staging)
        run: |
          # red-team-service runs one scan per asyncio task in a single process.
          # CPU/memory scale-out adds a new replica mid-scan which incorrectly
          # marks the in-flight run as service_restarted. HTTP scaling is enough.
          az containerapp update \
            --name "red-team-service-staging" \
            --resource-group Stage \
            --remove-all-scale-rules \
            --output none \
          && az containerapp update \
            --name "red-team-service-staging" \
            --resource-group Stage \
            --scale-rule-name http-scaling \
            --scale-rule-type http \
            --scale-rule-http-concurrency 100 \
            --output none \
          || echo "Warning: scale rule update for red-team-service-staging failed"

      - name: Raise liveness/readiness probe timeouts for scan services (Staging)
        run: |
          # Scan services fire 20+ concurrent LLM streaming calls during payload
          # generation, saturating the asyncio event loop long enough that /health
          # cannot respond within the default 1s probe timeout. After 3 failures
          # (10s period x 3 = 30s), ACA kills the container and the scan is
          # orphaned with status service_restarted.
          # Fix: raise probeTimeoutSeconds to 30s and probePeriodSeconds to 60s,
          # matching the values set via infra/main.bicep for dev (PR #351).
          #
          # IMPORTANT: az rest PATCH on containers[] replaces the entire container
          # object — it strips env vars if you only send name+image+probes. We must
          # fetch the full container spec first and merge the probes in via jq so
          # that all env vars, resources, volumeMounts etc. are preserved.
          SUBSCRIPTION="fb4c60ce-198d-408f-b426-e1fe06fd704a"
          RG=Stage
          API="2026-03-02-preview"
          declare -A SVC_PORTS=(["red-team-service-staging"]="8002" ["behavior-service-staging"]="8003")
          for APP in red-team-service-staging behavior-service-staging; do
            PORT="${SVC_PORTS[$APP]}"
            # Fetch the full current container spec (preserves env vars, resources, etc.)
            CONTAINER_JSON=$(az containerapp show --name "$APP" --resource-group "$RG" \
              --query "properties.template.containers[0]" -o json 2>/dev/null)
            if [ -z "$CONTAINER_JSON" ] || [ "$CONTAINER_JSON" = "null" ]; then
              echo "Warning: could not get container spec for $APP — skipping probe update"
              continue
            fi
            # Merge desired probes into the existing container spec via jq
            UPDATED_CONTAINER=$(echo "$CONTAINER_JSON" | jq \
              --argjson port "$PORT" \
              '.probes = [
                {"type":"Liveness",  "httpGet":{"path":"/health","port":$port}, "initialDelaySeconds":10, "periodSeconds":60, "timeoutSeconds":30, "failureThreshold":3},
                {"type":"Readiness", "httpGet":{"path":"/health","port":$port}, "initialDelaySeconds":10, "periodSeconds":60, "timeoutSeconds":30, "failureThreshold":3}
              ]')
            BODY=$(jq -n --argjson c "$UPDATED_CONTAINER" \
              '{"properties":{"template":{"containers":[$c]}}}')
            az rest --method PATCH \
              --uri "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/${SUBSCRIPTION}/resourceGroups/${RG}/providers/Microsoft.App/containerapps/${APP}?api-version=${API}" \
              --body "$BODY" --output none \
            && echo "Probe timeouts updated for $APP" \
            || echo "Warning: probe update for $APP failed"
          done

      - name: Deactivate old revisions
        run: |
          RG=Stage
          SUFFIX="-staging"
          for SVC in data-service ai-asset-service assessment-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service sn-integration-service; do
            LATEST=$(az containerapp revision list \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" --resource-group $RG \
              --query "[-1].name" -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
            if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then continue; fi
            OLD=$(az containerapp revision list \
              --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" --resource-group $RG \
              --query "[?properties.active && name!='${LATEST}'].name" -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
            for REV in $OLD; do
              az containerapp revision deactivate \
                --name "${SVC}${SUFFIX}" --resource-group $RG \
                --revision "$REV" --output none 2>/dev/null \
              && echo "Deactivated ${REV}" || true
            done
          done

      - name: Health check
        run: |
          GATEWAY_FQDN=$(az containerapp show --name "gateway-staging" --resource-group Stage \
            --query "properties.configuration.ingress.fqdn" -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          if [ -z "$GATEWAY_FQDN" ]; then
            echo "Warning: Could not resolve gateway FQDN — skipping health check"
          else
            echo "Polling https://${GATEWAY_FQDN}/health (max 3 min)..."
            for i in $(seq 1 36); do
              if curl -sf "https://${GATEWAY_FQDN}/health" > /dev/null; then
                echo "✅ Gateway healthy after $((i * 5))s"
                break
              fi
              echo "  attempt $i/36 — waiting 5s..."
              sleep 5
              [ $i -eq 36 ] && echo "Warning: Health check still failing after 3 min"
            done
          fi

      - name: Notify deployment
        run: |
          echo "✅ Deployed to Staging: https://api-staging.nuguard.ai"

  # ============================================================
  # Deploy to Production (release tags)
  # ============================================================
  deploy-prod:
    name: Deploy to Production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [build, tag, migrate]
    if: github.event_name == 'release'
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://api.nuguard.ai
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Azure Login (OIDC)
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      # LLM API keys are managed as Key Vault-backed secrets by Bicep (infra/main.bicep).
      # They auto-refresh from nuguard-prod-kv and persist across image updates.

      - name: Ensure behavior-service exists in Production
        run: |
          TAG=${{ needs.tag.outputs.image_tag }}
          RG=Prod
          SVC="behavior-service"
          APP_NAME="$SVC"
          KV_NAME=nuguard-prod-kv

          if az containerapp show --name "$APP_NAME" --resource-group "$RG" --output none 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "$APP_NAME already exists"
            exit 0
          fi

          ENV_ID=$(az containerapp show --name "data-service" --resource-group "$RG" --query properties.managedEnvironmentId -o tsv)
          IDENTITY_ID=$(az containerapp show --name "data-service" --resource-group "$RG" --query "identity.userAssignedIdentities | keys(@)[0]" -o tsv)
          JWT_SECRET=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name nuguard-jwt-secret --query value -o tsv)
          DB_URL=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name DATABASE-URL --query value -o tsv)

          echo "::add-mask::$JWT_SECRET"
          echo "::add-mask::$DB_URL"

          az containerapp create \
            --name "$APP_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --environment "$ENV_ID" \
            --image "${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${SVC}:${TAG}" \
            --ingress internal \
            --target-port 8003 \
            --min-replicas 1 \
            --max-replicas 3 \
            --cpu 0.5 \
            --memory 1.0Gi \
            --user-assigned "$IDENTITY_ID" \
            --registry-server "${{ env.REGISTRY }}" \
            --registry-identity "$IDENTITY_ID" \
            --secrets jwt-secret="$JWT_SECRET" database-url="$DB_URL" \
            --env-vars \
              ENVIRONMENT=production \
              JWT_SECRET_KEY=secretref:jwt-secret \
              DATABASE_URL=secretref:database-url \
              CORS_ORIGINS='["https://app.nuguard.ai"]' \
            --output none

      - name: Ensure behavior-service has DATABASE_URL in Production
        run: |
          # Idempotent patch — injects DATABASE_URL into already-running behavior-service.
          KV_NAME=nuguard-prod-kv
          RG=Prod
          DB_URL=$(az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name DATABASE-URL --query value -o tsv)
          echo "::add-mask::$DB_URL"
          az containerapp secret set \
            --name behavior-service \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --secrets database-url="$DB_URL" \
            --output none || true
          az containerapp update \
            --name behavior-service \
            --resource-group "$RG" \
            --set-env-vars DATABASE_URL=secretref:database-url \
            --output none || true

      - name: Ensure red-team-service has DATABASE_URL in Production
        run: |
          # Idempotent patch — wires DATABASE_URL to the Bicep-provisioned database-url secret.
          # CI runner cannot read nuguard-prod-kv, so we skip the KV read and just wire
          # the secretref. The secret is resolved by the ACA managed identity at runtime.
          az containerapp update \
            --name red-team-service \
            --resource-group Prod \
            --set-env-vars DATABASE_URL=secretref:database-url \
            --output none || true

      # Canary deployment - 10% traffic initially (100% on first deployment)
      - name: Deploy data-service to Production (Canary)
        run: |
          TAG=${{ needs.tag.outputs.image_tag }}
          RG=Prod

          az containerapp revision copy \
            --name data-service \
            --resource-group $RG \
            --image ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/data-service:${TAG} \
            --revision-suffix ${TAG} \
            --set-env-vars ENVIRONMENT=production DATA_SERVICE_URL=http://data-service:80 AI_ASSET_SERVICE_URL=http://ai-asset-service:80 ASSESSMENT_SERVICE_URL=http://assessment-service:80 RED_TEAM_SERVICE_URL=http://red-team-service:80 SN_INTEGRATION_SERVICE_URL=http://sn-integration-service:80

          # Get previous active revision for canary split (empty on first deploy)
          PREV=$(az containerapp revision list \
            --name data-service --resource-group $RG \
            --query "[?properties.active && name!='data-service--${TAG}'].name | [0]" \
            -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")

          if [ -n "$PREV" ]; then
            az containerapp ingress traffic set \
              --name data-service \
              --resource-group $RG \
              --revision-weight \
                data-service--${TAG}=10 \
                ${PREV}=90
          else
            echo "No previous revision found - routing 100% to new revision"
            az containerapp ingress traffic set \
              --name data-service \
              --resource-group $RG \
              --revision-weight data-service--${TAG}=100
          fi

      - name: Deploy remaining services to Production
        run: |
          TAG=${{ needs.tag.outputs.image_tag }}
          RG=Prod
          EXTRA_VARS="DATA_SERVICE_URL=http://data-service:80 AI_ASSET_SERVICE_URL=http://ai-asset-service:80 ASSESSMENT_SERVICE_URL=http://assessment-service:80 RED_TEAM_SERVICE_URL=http://red-team-service:80 SN_INTEGRATION_SERVICE_URL=http://sn-integration-service:80"

          for SVC in ai-asset-service assessment-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service sn-integration-service; do
            az containerapp update \
              --name "${SVC}" \
              --resource-group $RG \
              --image "${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${SVC}:${TAG}" \
              --set-env-vars ENVIRONMENT=production ${EXTRA_VARS} \
            || echo "Warning: ${SVC} deploy failed"
          done

      - name: Set JWT_SECRET_KEY for auth-enabled services (Production)
        run: |
          # behavior-service and red-team-service validate JWT tokens for all
          # authenticated endpoints. They need the same jwt-secret as data-service.
          # ai-chatbot-service also requires it for WebSocket auth.
          #
          # In production the CI runner cannot read nuguard-prod-kv (no RBAC grant),
          # so we cannot patch the secret value itself. Instead we only wire the
          # JWT_SECRET_KEY env var to the existing jwt-secret (provisioned by Bicep
          # as a keyvaultref, resolved by the ACA managed identity at runtime).
          # This is idempotent and safe to run on every deploy.
          RG=Prod
          for SVC in ai-chatbot-service behavior-service red-team-service; do
            az containerapp update \
              --name "${SVC}" \
              --resource-group "$RG" \
              --set-env-vars JWT_SECRET_KEY=secretref:jwt-secret \
              --output none \
            && echo "JWT_SECRET_KEY wired for ${SVC}" \
            || echo "Warning: JWT wire for ${SVC} failed"
          done

      - name: Set CORS origins for backend services
        run: |
          RG=Prod
          for SVC in data-service ai-asset-service assessment-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service sn-integration-service; do
            az containerapp update \
              --name "${SVC}" \
              --resource-group $RG \
              --set-env-vars 'CORS_ORIGINS=["https://app.nuguard.ai"]' \
            || echo "Warning: CORS update for ${SVC} failed"
          done

      - name: Enable internal-only ACA ingress on backend services
        run: |
          RG=Prod
          declare -A PORTS=(
            ["data-service"]="8000"
            ["ai-asset-service"]="8004"
            ["assessment-service"]="8005"
            ["red-team-service"]="8002"
            ["behavior-service"]="8003"
            ["ai-chatbot-service"]="8006"
            ["sn-integration-service"]="8007"
          )
          for SVC in data-service ai-asset-service assessment-service red-team-service behavior-service ai-chatbot-service sn-integration-service; do
            PORT="${PORTS[$SVC]}"
            az containerapp ingress update \
              --name "${SVC}" --resource-group "$RG" \
              --type internal 2>/dev/null \
            || az containerapp ingress enable \
              --name "${SVC}" --resource-group "$RG" \
              --type internal --target-port "$PORT" --transport auto 2>/dev/null \
            || echo "Warning: Could not set internal ingress for ${SVC}"
          done

      - name: Deploy nginx gateway to Production
        run: |
          TAG=${{ needs.tag.outputs.image_tag }}
          RG=Prod
          az containerapp update \
            --name "gateway" \
            --resource-group $RG \
            --image "${{ env.REGISTRY }}/gateway:${TAG}" \
            --set-env-vars \
              DATA_SERVICE_HOST=data-service:80 \
              DATA_SERVICE_NAME=data-service \
              AI_ASSET_SERVICE_HOST=ai-asset-service:80 \
              AI_ASSET_SERVICE_NAME=ai-asset-service \
              ASSESSMENT_SERVICE_HOST=assessment-service:80 \
              ASSESSMENT_SERVICE_NAME=assessment-service \
              RED_TEAM_SERVICE_HOST=red-team-service:80 \
              RED_TEAM_SERVICE_NAME=red-team-service \
              AI_CHATBOT_SERVICE_HOST=ai-chatbot-service:80 \
              AI_CHATBOT_SERVICE_NAME=ai-chatbot-service \
              BEHAVIOR_SERVICE_HOST=behavior-service:80 \
              BEHAVIOR_SERVICE_NAME=behavior-service \
                SN_INTEGRATION_SERVICE_HOST=sn-integration-service:80 \
                SN_INTEGRATION_SERVICE_NAME=sn-integration-service \
              NGINX_RESOLVER=168.63.129.16 \
              NGINX_FRONTEND_URL=off \
          || echo "Warning: gateway deploy failed (may not exist yet — run Bicep first)"

      - name: Canary health check
        run: |
          sleep 60
          GATEWAY_FQDN=$(az containerapp show --name "gateway" --resource-group Prod \
            --query "properties.configuration.ingress.fqdn" -o tsv 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          if [ -n "$GATEWAY_FQDN" ]; then
            for i in {1..5}; do
              curl -f "https://${GATEWAY_FQDN}/health" || echo "Warning: Health check attempt $i failed"
              sleep 5
            done
          else
            echo "Warning: Could not resolve gateway FQDN for health check"
          fi

      # Full rollout after canary validation
      - name: Promote data-service to 100% traffic
        run: |
          TAG=${{ needs.tag.outputs.image_tag }}
          az containerapp ingress traffic set \
            --name data-service \
            --resource-group Prod \
            --revision-weight data-service--${TAG}=100

      - name: Notify deployment
        run: |
          echo "🚀 Deployed to Production: https://api.nuguard.ai"
          echo "Release: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"

  # ============================================================
  # Database Migrations (runs on staging/prod deploys)
